column1: https://www.python.org/,"## Quick Tour of the Python.org Home Page
Welcome to the official home of the Python programming language! Here’s what you’ll find at a glance:

column3: What It Offers
A friendly “Beginner’s Guide” for newcomers and a clear path to start coding in Python.
Links to the latest Python releases (e.g., **Python 3.14.7**) and installers for all platforms.
Full documentation, tutorials, and reference material for Python’s standard library (via docs.python.org).
A community‑run job board (jobs.python.org) for Python‑related positions—both hiring and job‑seeking.
Recent announcements such as AWS powering PyPI, new packaging council candidates, and fresh Python releases (e.g., 3.12.14, 3.11.16).
Upcoming conferences and meet‑ups worldwide (e.g., PyDay Angola, DjangoCon US, PyCon in several countries).
Real‑world examples of teams (like Force Therapeutics) using Python to solve challenges.

Quick links to popular libraries across domains:
• **Web** – Django, Flask, FastAPI, etc.
• **GUI** – Tkinter, PyQt, Kivy…
• **AI/ML** – PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit‑learn…
• **Science** – SciPy, Pandas, IPython…
• **DevOps** – Ansible, Salt, OpenStack…
Mission statement about promoting, protecting, and advancing Python; options to learn more, become a member, or donate.

column1: Overall, the page is a welcoming hub that helps you **learn Python**, **download the latest version**, **find help and community resources**, and stay up‑to‑date with news, events, and career opportunities. Happy coding!",2026-08-22 22:04:35.591062
